theorems.name: Submission.doraggt_ae_approxTangent_transfer
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (W A B : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen W → MeasurableSet A → MeasurableSet B → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ W → μHE[n] (A ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ W → μHE[n] (B ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Euclid P)), x ∈ W → x ∈ A → x ∈ B → ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n A x Q ↔ HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n B x Q
